name: Four Seasons Hotel Boston
positioning: Four Seasons hotel in Boston's Back Bay at 200 Boylston Street, overlooking the Public Garden, with a lobby renovated by Ken Fulk in 2023
best_for: Travelers who want a Back Bay base overlooking the Public Garden
Guests who enjoy complimentary touches such as The Vault snack pantries and Sottovento Coffee Bar

facts.text: The hotel is at 200 Boylston Street in Boston's Back Bay neighbourhood.
The hotel overlooks the Public Garden.
The hotel is a 15-minute drive from Logan International Airport.
Ken Fulk designed the 2023 lobby and porte cochere renovation.
Guest rooms were last renovated in 2017.
Patrice Martineau is the Executive Chef.
Aujourd'hui is the hotel's breakfast restaurant.
Coterie is an intimate, brasserie style lobby lounge serving lunch and dinner.
The hotel has an eighth-floor heated indoor pool.
The hotel has a 24-hour fitness facility.

highlights.text: The Vault is a complimentary snack pantry on every guest room floor.
Sottovento Coffee Bar offers complimentary gourmet espresso and coffee beverages for guests.
The Coffee Concierge can have a morning cup delivered to the guest room within 20 minutes.
The sixth-floor Royal Suite has a private cinema.
Executive Chef Patrice Martineau leads the Boston Run Club, a morning jog highlighting Boston's most iconic neighborhoods and historic sites.

considerations.text: There isn't a dedicated spa on-site.
There are two Boylston Street locations in the city of Boston.
WhataHotel notes that premium pricing reflects the luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
